title: S2: Emotion loader, dev-100 and final slices, stratified label order
description:
## Purpose

Load Emotion from the committed manifest and local HF cache and lay out leakage-free slices.

## Scope

Loader from `studies/manifests/emotion.json` + `.data/huggingface/dair-ai___emotion` (ids `train-N` / `test-N`); dev-100 and a disjoint final slice from test via `seeded_slices`; pool from train; stratified `label_order` (seeded shuffle within label, round-robin across labels) so every 150-label round has >= 25 per class; leakage asserts (pool/dev/final disjoint by id and text hash).

## Specs (first, beside the module)

ids follow `train-N` / `test-N`; slices disjoint and seed-stable; each round >= 25 per class; leakage assert fires on an injected overlap.

## Reuse

`seeded_slices`, `round_batches`.

## Definition of done

Specs pass offline with a fixture; manifest revision and slice ids recorded; no dataset text committed.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
